subject: Closure Notice WX-908 - All Regional Sites
body: Due to the severe weather alert, all Northstar regional sites must close at 16:00 Asia/Shanghai on September 8, 2026. Site leads should confirm the building sweep and remote-work activation through the regional incident bridge. Reopening will be announced separately by Corporate Safety. Incident WX-908.
dispatch_limit: One final notice per current regional lead
follow_up: Regional incident bridges and the call tree provide downstream delivery confirmation outside this email interface.
